text:
elaine: Quick heads-up, running the async sample (examples/async_chat_stream.py) against local dev infra leaves sockets in ESTABLISHED after canceling the stream. Repro steps below.

mike: can you drop steps + a tiny snippet?

elaine: Steps: 1) start the sample against local dev stack; 2) begin streaming a long response; 3) cancel via Ctrl-C or client-side cancel; 4) `ss -tnp | grep python` shows lingering ESTABLISHED sockets to inference; 5) repeat and sockets pile up until memory-ish OOM.

elaine: Minimal async snippet I used:
```
async def run():
    stream = client.responses.stream(model="redwood-qa", input="long-running stream")
    try:
        async for ev in stream:
            print(ev)
    finally:
        # expecting this to always run
        await stream.aclose()
```

priyanka: we do have a sync wrapper in samples that only exposes `.close()` right? that might hide `aclose()` in stubs. typing parity issue.

tomas: my hunch: when CancelledError races with token refresh or a background reader task, the generator finalizer path isn't awaited, so the underlying httpx transport/stream stays open.

elaine: observed logs after cancelling: `Task was destroyed but it is pending!
Task exception was never retrieved
ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer`

mike: which transport is used in the sample wrapper? httpx AsyncClient or aiohttp?

elaine: httpx AsyncClient via our http wrapper. We close the top-level client on shutdown, but each stream holds a transport/response object that isn't always closed on generator cancellation.

priyanka: short-term mitigation: call `await client.http.aclose()` in your app shutdown handler or set `SAMPLE_TRANSPORT_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=1` env var in samples.

mike: we should also add typing: make stream object implement `typing.AsyncIterator` with `aclose()` and `__aexit__` so mypy catches missing calls. current stub hides `aclose`.

tomas: opened GH issue with tiny repro + pytest-asyncio CI run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4267 — includes ss output and a cancelling test that fails when we regress.

elaine: proposed plan: (1) add a cancellable test that replicates ESTABLISHED sockets; (2) modify stream object's `aclose()` to cancel the reader task and force-close the transport; (3) update types/stubs and the sync wrapper to include `.aclose()` in typing; (4) add sample README note about graceful shutdown.

mike: implementation note: when canceling reader tasks, swallow CancelledError in the finalizer but ensure underlying transport gets `await transport.aclose()` in all paths. Also add a small backoff to avoid double-close races.

priyanka: i'll follow up with a typing patch for stubs. We should also make the sync wrapper call `anyio.run(client.responses.stream(...).__aexit__)` or similar so people using sync samples don't leak.

elaine: I'll tackle the stream finalizer + sample README. tagging @mike @priyanka for review.

devx-bot: reminder — link PR to changelog and include `fix: async sample stream socket leak on cancel` in release notes.

mike: I can help convert the repro into a CI flake detector (small job) so this doesn't regress.

elaine: that would be awesome, thanks — will post branch soon.
